notes: Statuses judged against the integrated tip origin/codex/handshake-studio-assets 87f331f9 (already current in the clean tree; no fetch) and ledger lane status; microtask status ignored as instructed.

VALIDATED = a covering PASS_Vn lane plus tip code; BUILT_NOT_VALIDATED = tip code whose covering lane is READY_FOR_VALIDATION (STUDIO-R60 never opened, so 28 READY lanes are unjudged); LOCAL = only in an unpushed lane (SMB-DELIVERY-QUEUE-1).

Following the parity-20261111 rule, a clause stays PARTIAL while a sub-capability it names is absent, declared as a gap in a module header, or refused typed (e.g. content-aware fit, PDF/X stock presets, nested table cells).

Clauses whose remaining part is kernel integration (EventLedger events and receipts, SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables, CKC registration, DCC approval inbox, shell prefix registration) are PARTIAL or MISSING here: STU-OVR-001 schedules that integration later and none of it is in the asset tree.

Lane-file ids that differ from ledger ids were mapped: SMB-CONTROLS-2 = ledger SMB-CONTROLS (PASS_V16, lane file hsk-studio-controls.json); SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR-1 = ledger SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR (PASS_V37).

Some index lane links are incidental (e.g. STU-MDL-002 -> SMB-PDF-STOCK-PRESETS-1, STU-IO-190 -> SMB-INTEROP-VECTOR-1); where a code header names a different owning lane (grids.rs -> SMB-ID-PREPRESS, book.rs -> SMB-LAYOUT-UI) that lane was used as the covering lane.

NOT_PRODUCT covers headings, 14.6.0 reading rules (STU-LAY-100, 102-104), derivation indexes and microtask rules (STU-LAY-199, STU-IO-168..172), the IO promotion gate and row-law (STU-IO-004, 007), supersession/scope statements (STU-IO-100, STU-OVR-015, STU-SECTION-002) and the count-honesty review rule (STU-IO-154).
The index line for several ids points at a cross-reference; section and title in rows come from the definitional clause (spec_line), not from the index line.

ui = window where the egui harness-view layout editor (layout_ui/*.rs), develop export dialog, timeline export or the native Vulkan host (native-host gui, kumihimo-ui) has a control; command = typed row or engine only; null for MISSING, LOCAL and NOT_PRODUCT. Window reach was read from file presence and headers only, not by running the window.
Read only: no cargo, build or test run; no product file edited; nothing committed. Code read with git grep / git show on the tip object only.
